title: Post-doctoral Fellow
description:
Post-doctoral Fellow in the Department of Real Estate and
Construction (Ref.: 519152)

We now invite applications for the Post-doctoral Fellow in the
Department of Real Estate and Construction. The Department enjoys a
world-class reputation for its research and teaching in real estate
and construction fields. Under the QS University Rankings 2022, it
is ranked in the 14th position in the subject of Built Environment
globally.

Duties and Responsibilities

The appointee will work on a project related to urban
entrepreneurship.
The appointee will employ mathematical modelling skills to
specify the relationship between start-ups, developers, and
planners under a framework of spatial equilibrium.
The appointee will coordinate data collection and
analysis.
The appointee will assist in the preparation of reports.

Requirements

a Ph.D. degree in applied mathematics, urban economics, data
science or related subjects from a world leading university.
Applicants should have a research background in mathematical
and computational modelling.
Preference will be given to the applicants with specialised
skills in calculus, spatial equilibrium model, and equilibrium
sorting model.
Applicants with an outstanding track record of publications and
research project experience will be an advantage.

What We Offer

The appointment will commence as soon as possible on a temporary
basis for one year, with the possibility of renewal subject to
satisfactory performance and funding availability. A highly
competitive salary commensurate with qualifications and experience
will be offered. Other benefits include annual leave, medical
benefits and free access to on-campus gyms and libraries.

How to Apply

The University only accepts online application for the above
post(s). Applicants should apply online at the University’s Careers
site ( https://jobs.hku.hk ) and
upload an up-to-date C.V. Review of applications will start as soon
as possible and continue until the post is filled, whichever is
earlier.

The appointee will join a multidisciplinary team led by Prof.
Kelvin Wong, Dr. Alex Shi, and Dr. Jintao Ke. Prof. Wong is the
Head of Department of Real Estate and Construction and a leading
scholar in real estate economics; Dr. Shi is an Assistant Professor
in urban economics from Department of Real Estate and Construction;
Dr. Ke is an Assistant Professor in transportation engineering from
the Department of Civil Engineering. If you have any enquiry about
the post, please contact Dr. Shi via alexshi@hku.hk .

The University is an equal opportunities employer
and
is committed to equality, ethics, inclusivity, diversity and
transparency

Advertised: Feb 2, 2023 (HK Time)
